items.quote: My car looks brand new!! They came over on time and performed a beautiful interior and exterior detail. I'm very happy with the results and will definitely be booking with Marcos Ortiz again!

My car hasn't been this sparkling clean since we bought it! Marcos was thorough, and seemed to have reached every nook and cranny. Prime Detailing and Pressure Washing was professional, reliable and I would highly recommend them, they exceeded my expectations.
Marcus did a beautiful job on my Honda CR-V Touring. When I got in the car it was as new as when I bought it. Marcus is very professional and I will continue to use his services.
Amazing job on the car detail. Service was super smooth and professional and showed up the very next day to detail the car. Would 100% recommend to a friend or family.
Never seen my truck this cleaned in months. Very professional And on time I highly recommend
